inspector: AI-assisted actual-PDF layout inspection in this revision session
scope: All page layouts through rendered contact sheets, plus declared full-page detailed checks. This is not independent mathematical peer review and does not claim that every historical proof was re-proved visually.
contact_layout: 3 columns by at most 4 rows; 450 by 650 pixel tiles; separate page renders retained during inspection

ECTA.method: pdftoppm rasterization of the hash-matched current PDF; all-page contact-sheet review plus targeted full-page review
ECTA.findings: All 90 page layouts inspected in contact sheets. New Theorem 24 and Proposition 25 inspected in full-page renders on pages 51 and 53. Equations, statewise inequalities, bibliography, original title/author, headers and line-number margins remain legible and contained. No clipping or overlap observed.
